settings.intro: Content on this site is made with AI. We say so openly.

settings.heading: The risks are real
settings.text: AI can damage the social fabric. It can concentrate power in fewer hands. It can replace work that people depend on.

settings.heading: Social media is the comparison
settings.text: Social media turned people against each other. It also raised awareness.

settings.heading: A tool for good
settings.text: A tool can be used for bad or for good. We try to use AI for good: for awareness, for education, and for solidarity.

settings.heading: What we promise
settings.text:
We will be transparent about what is AI-assisted. We will not pretend that AI removes the need for human judgement, maintenance, or accountability.

Read more in the Manifesto.

settings.heading: Contribute
settings.text: Teach us something new. Challenge an assumption. Point us toward a problem we have missed.
